about: Karl's own tiers. A card named in "cards" gets this tier whatever Forge's archetype data, the restricted list or its rarity say (rpg/tiers.py). Tiers: 0 Basic, 1 Common, 2 Solid, 3 Strong, 4 Elite, 5 Power. Example: "Lightning Bolt": 3. "rules" (round RPG3): lands_max caps every non-basic land, common_max caps every card ever printed at common or uncommon; null = off. Neither touches the restricted list or a card named in "cards". tools/rpg_build_data.py compare shows what each would change.
